scraped.title: Privatisation in Afghanistan
scraped.subtitle: Privatisation in Afghanistan
scraped.financing: Bundesministerium für wirtschaftliche Zusammenarbeit und Entwicklung (BMZ)
scraped.clientName: Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH
scraped.description: Privatisation played a key role in Afghanistan's broader state enterprise reform, as outlined in the Afghanistan Interim Administration's National Development Framework (NDF).
body: Privatisation played a key role in Afghanistan's broader state enterprise reform, as outlined in the Afghanistan Interim Administration's National Development Framework (NDF).

ICON-INSTITUT was contracted by the GTZ to support the private sector and market forces in regard to more effectiveness in driving sustained growth than state-led efforts. and second, that the rule of law, transparency, and a supportive environment were essential for enabling private sector development and fostering long-term economic progress.
